{{Top|leg}}
The '''Coruscant Institute''' was a [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] organization that operated in [[14 ABY/Legends|14 ABY]] under the reign of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. This institute owned the [[Quarantine Enforcement Cruiser]] ''[[Lycoming]]''. Two employees of this institute were [[Tuuve]], the [[Gotal/Legends|Gotal]] [[Chief medical officer]] of the ''Lycoming'', and a female [[Unidentified Gotal captain|Gotal captain]] who was in command of the ''Lycoming''.
